campaigns.title: Fake carrier fraud department calls
campaigns.tactic_summary: Caller claims to be your phone carrier's fraud team and asks for the code just texted to you.
campaigns.sample_text: This is the fraud department at your carrier. We stopped a suspicious SIM swap. Read me the 6 digit code we just sent to verify your identity.

campaigns.title: Unpaid toll texts
campaigns.tactic_summary: Text says you owe a small toll fee and links to a fake payment page.
campaigns.sample_text: TxTag: You have an unpaid toll balance of $4.35. Pay now to avoid a $50 late fee: https://txtag-pay.top/invoice

campaigns.title: Grandchild emergency calls
campaigns.tactic_summary: Someone pretends to be a grandchild in trouble, asks for money or gift cards, and begs you not to tell anyone.
campaigns.sample_text: Grandpa it's me, I got arrested and I need bail money. Please don't tell mom. Can you get gift cards?

campaigns.title: Remote job offers
campaigns.tactic_summary: Unsolicited job offer with high pay for simple tasks, later asks for an upfront deposit.
campaigns.sample_text: Hi, I'm a recruiter. We have a remote part-time role paying $300/day liking products online. Reply YES to start.

campaigns.title: Scam recovery offers
campaigns.tactic_summary: After a scam, someone offers to recover your lost money for an upfront fee.
campaigns.sample_text: We are the Fund Recovery Unit. We located the money you lost. Pay a $199 processing fee to release your refund.

report_evidence.text_redacted: TxTag notice: unpaid toll of $3.95. Pay today or a $50 fee applies: https://txtag-pay.top/pay
NTTA: Your account has an outstanding toll. Settle within 24 hours to avoid penalties: ntta-tollpay.xyz
Caller said they were from the carrier fraud team, said someone tried to move my number, and asked me to read back the code they texted.
Someone said he was my grandson in jail, needed bail, asked for gift cards and said not to tell his parents.
Hi mom, this is my new number, my phone broke. Save this one. Can you help me pay a bill today?
We recovered funds lost to the scam. A release fee of $250 is required to transfer your refund.

demo_messages.text: TxTag: You have an unpaid toll balance of $6.80. Pay by tonight to avoid a $50 late fee: https://txtag-pay.top/inv/88213
demo_messages.reason: This is a fake toll notice. The link goes to a site many people have reported, not the real toll agency.
tips: Check your toll account in the official app or website.

demo_messages.text: Hey Grandpa it's me, I got a new number. My old phone broke. Can you text me back here?
demo_messages.reason: "New number, it's me" texts are a common way scammers pretend to be family. Check with Tommy on his saved number first.
tips: Ask for the family code word.

demo_messages.text: Fund Recovery Unit: we located the $1,200 you lost. Pay a $199 processing fee today to release your refund.
demo_messages.reason: Real agencies never charge a fee to return lost money. This matches a recovery scam many people have reported.
